summary: Arkansas Forestry Commission wood tower, 115 ft, described in a 1941 federal survey; no source found on its fate or current status.

facts.design: Wood structure with an 8-by-8-foot crow's nest and a 2-foot catwalk

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station description: wood structure, 115 feet high, with an 8-by-8-foot crow's nest

evidence.supports: Survey station located 4 miles west and 1 mile south of Wilton, Little River County
1941 survey: structure built of wood, 115 feet high
evidence.quote: STRUCTURE IS BUILT OF WOOD AND IS 115 FEET HIGH.

evidence.supports: Catwalk 2 feet wide around the crow's nest
Station described by Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1941
evidence.quote: DESCRIBED BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1941 (FBQ)

evidence.supports: Agency is the Arkansas Forestry Commission
Survey station is in Little River County
Listed name carries the uncertain Wilton label and Unit 10, Tower 3
Survey point is the centre of the top of the crow's nest
evidence.quote: POINT LOCATED WAS THE CENTER OF THE TOP OF CROWS-NEST

evidence.supports: NGS lists the station as LOOKOUT TOWER 10+3 AFC
Arkansas Forestry Commission established by Act 234 in 1931 and built towers
evidence.quote: The Arkansas Forestry Commission was established by Act 234 in 1931, and it too built many more towers.

evidence.supports: Statewide: 122 fire towers at the peak; 48 still standing in 1994
evidence.quote: At the height of their operation, Arkansas had 122 known fire towers. In 1994, forty-eight still stood

corrections.why: The NGS listing for the lookout tower station (DM1177) gives an approximate position of 33 43 06 / 094 13 02, about 1.1 km from the record point. The NGS description places the survey point at the centre of the top of the crow's nest. The proposed values are the NGS position truncated to whole seconds; a reviewer should confirm against the full NGS datasheet.

notes_for_editor: Single physical source: a 1941 Coast and Geodetic Survey description, carried on centraluslookouts. No build date, status or access found. Name still uncertain: page title and survey label both carry 'Wilton ?' with a question mark; the page heading reads Unit 10. Tower 3, and the NGS listing calls the station LOOKOUT TOWER 10+3 AFC. Location correction proposed: record point is about 1.1 km from the NGS station position; the NGS listing gives coordinates truncated to whole seconds, so confirm against the full datasheet before applying. Leads not read: an Arkansas State Archives 1955 operations map of the Forestry and Parks Commission (search summary only; no legend or counties checked); a Little River County Forestry Commission map on digitalheritage.arkansas.gov (that domain did not resolve for our reader); Bill Beasley, Little River County (Ashdown, 1975), cited by the Encyclopedia of Arkansas Wilton entry, which mentions no lookout. Height 115 ft is the 1941 figure only; not confirmed current.
